content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "This judge text decides the D5/C5 Isaiah 7:14 chain collision by noting the challenger's and defender's answers, so it is the kind of chain-vs-chain assessment K-C governs.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires", "room": "I interpreted 'never verse by verse' as requiring chain-level weighing but allowing an underdetermined finding when both chains have separate footing; the contrary reading would forbid noting separate wording and application answers unless each verse stated the contrary.", "why": "The judge does not require a single verse to state the contrary; it treats both sides' chain answers as leaving the link underdetermined, which is consistent with K-C."}
